title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: In the context of one-hot encoding, each type of meat (beef, chicken, fish) is represented by a separate binary variable. For example, if the meat is beef, then $$meat=beef$$ is $$1$$, and the others are $$0$$.

title: Understanding Model Weights
